verdict.rationale: Extend's changelog says parse runs return `chunks` on the output, now alongside a `metadata` object. That shows parsed output is segmented with metadata rather than returned as a wall of text. The parsing overview adds structure-aware handling of tables, figures and equations, but nothing describes how chunk boundaries are chosen or whether segments suit embedding. missing for 10: documentation of semantic or section-aware chunking strategy, chunk-size or embedding-ready configuration, detail on per-chunk metadata fields, independent or hands-on corroboration of RAG chunk quality.
